info.title: LeadSquared Sales - Upload and attach a file

Status.description: Indicates the result of the request.

uploadedFile.description: The file name of the uploaded file, including its extension.

relativeFilePath.description: The relative path of the uploaded file.

s3FilePath.description: The pre-signed URL to access the uploaded file from cloud storage.

description.description: The description of the uploaded file. Returns `null` if no description is provided.

post.description:
Uploads a file to your LeadSquared account. Returns the file name in the `uploadedFile` response parameter. We recommend uploading files to leads or activities via associated [Custom Field Sets](https://help.leadsquared.com/custom-field-set/). Once the file has been uploaded successfully – - To attach the file to a specific lead, pass the file name returned from the `uploadedFile` parameter in a file-type CFS field associated with a lead. - To attach the file to a specific activity pass the file name returned from the `uploadedFile` parameter - In a file-type CFS field associated with an activity. - As an activity note. **Note:** The Upload File API currently supports uploading **only one file per request**. If multiple files are included in a single request, then **only the last file** in the request will be uploaded. To upload multiple files, you can: - **Zip the files** into a single archive and upload that. - **Make multiple API calls**, one for each file. ## API URL Use the URL specific to your region. | **Region** | **Request URL** | | --- | --- | | Singapore | `https://files.leadsquared.com/File/Upload` | | United States | `https://files-us11.leadsquared.com/File/Upload` | | India | `https://files-in21.leadsquared.com/File/Upload` | | Ireland | `https://files-ir31.leadsquared.com/File/Upload` | | Canada | `https://files-ca12.leadsquared.com/File/Upload` | | India (Hyderabad) | `https://files-in22.leadsquared.com/File/Upload` | | Dubai | `https://files-me61.leadsquared.com/File/Upload` | ## Payload `Content-Type: Multipart/form-data` | **Parameter** | **Description** | **Data Type** | **Required** | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `uploadFiles` | The file you want to upload . | `File` | Yes | | `FileType` | `0` = Document.
`1` = Image.
`3` = Lead Attachment.
`7` = Custom Field Set Document. | `Integer` | Yes | | `AccessKey` | Access Key of your LeadSquared account. | `String` | Yes | | `SecretKey` | Secret Key of your LeadSquared account . | `String` | Yes | | `FileStorageType` | `0` = Permanent.
`1` = Temporary. | `Integer` | Yes | | `EnableResize` | `true` or `false`

Always set to `false` for Custom Field Sets | `Boolean` | Yes | | `Id` | Pass the Lead Id if Entity is lead.

Pass the Opportunity Event Code if Entity is opportunity.

Pass the Activity Event Code if the entity is activity. | `String` | Yes | | `SchemaName` | Schema name of the file-type field within the custom field set. | `String` | Yes | | `EntitySchemaName` | Schema name of the lead/activity field with which the custom field set is associated. | `String` | Yes | | `Entity` | `0` = Lead.
`1` = Activity/Opportunity.

This is dependent on the Id that’s being passed. If you pass the Activity Event Code as the Id, and then pass 1 as the Entity, the corresponding activity is updated. Similarly, if you pass the Opportunity Event Code as the Id, and then pass 1 as the Entity, the corresponding opportunity is updated. | `Integer` | Yes | | `StorageVersion` | The storage version configured.
`0` is the default LeadSquared configuration

If you have your own storage configured, pass the value associated with it. For more information, contact your account manager. | `Integer` | Yes | ## Next Steps You can now add the uploaded file to a CFS associated with a lead (for example, by calling [Create a Lead](https://www.postman.com/leadsquaredapi/leadsquared-public-apis/request/xzykexe/create-a-lead?action=share&source=copy-link&creator=39502170&ctx=documentation), [Update a Lead](https://www.postman.com/leadsquaredapi/leadsquared-public-apis/request/sab2t0p/update-a-lead?action=share&source=copy-link&creator=39502170&ctx=documentation), etc.), or with an activity (for example, by calling Post Activity on Lead API, [Update an Activity](https://www.postman.com/leadsquaredapi/leadsquared-public-apis/request/c5r3e5a/update-an-activity?action=share&source=copy-link&creator=39502170&ctx=documentation), etc.). In the request body, pass `uploadedFile` from this response (file name) in the required CFS file-type field.

uploadFiles.description: The file you want to upload.

FileType.description:
`0` = Document.  
`1` = Image.  
`3` = Lead Attachment.  
`7` = Custom Field Set Document.

AccessKey.description: Access Key of your LeadSquared account.

SecretKey.description: Secret Key of your LeadSquared account .

EnableResize.description:
`true` or `false`  
  
Always set to `false` for Custom Field Sets.

Id.description:
Pass the Lead Id if Entity is lead.  
  
Pass the Opportunity Event Code if Entity is opportunity.  
  
Pass the Activity Event Code if the entity is activity.

SchemaName.description: Schema name of the file-type field within the custom field set.

EntitySchemaName.description: Schema name of the lead/activity field with which the custom field set is associated.

Entity.description:
`0` = Lead.  
`1` = Activity/Opportunity.  
  
This is dependent on the Id that’s being passed. If you pass the Activity Event Code as the Id, and then pass `1` as the Entity, the corresponding activity is updated. Similarly, if you pass the Opportunity Event Code as the Id, and then pass `1` as the Entity, the corresponding opportunity is updated.

StorageVersion.description:
The storage version configured.  
`0` is the default LeadSquared configuration  
  
If you have your own storage configured, pass the value associated with it. For more information, contact your account manager.

AccessKey.description: The `AccessKey` can be obtained on your LeadSquared dashboard. Navigate to **My Account>Settings>API and Webhooks>API Access Keys** section.

SecretKey.name: x-LSQ-SecretKey
SecretKey.description: The `SecretKey` can be obtained on your LeadSquared dashboard. Navigate to **My Account>Settings>API and Webhooks>API Access Keys** section.
